crossRefs.note: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter, and came to the tomb first.

people.name: Ahimaaz
people.line: Son of Zadok the priest, a messenger for David

people.name: Cush
people.line: Ancient region in Africa; associated with Egypt and Babylon

translations.web: “But come what may,” he said, “I will run.” He said to him, “Run!” Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the Plain, and outran the Cushite.
translations.bsb: “No matter what, I want to run!” he replied. “Then run!” Joab told him. So Ahimaaz ran by way of the plain and outran the Cushite.
translations.kjv: But howsoever, said he, let me run. And he said unto him, Run. Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain, and overran Cushi.
translations.asv: But come what may, said he, I will run. And he said unto him, Run. Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the Plain, and outran the Cushite.
